_comment: Skills. A skill has ranks 1..max_rank. Practice fills a bar; the bar for rank r -> r+1 needs practice_per_rank * r points. Up to self_taught_to, a full bar raises the rank by itself; beyond that, a full bar means you're ready to train, and a trainer (see data/workshops.json) charges training_cost for the next rank. Numbers are PLACEHOLDERS. attribute: the attribute whose points over 10 add to each bit of practice (+1 per 2 points); practice_base: practice per session before that. v0.64.0 (user: weapon skills and Tracking rose much too fast, Stealth not at all): weapon skills and Marksmanship 12 -> 30 practice a rank, Tracking 8 -> 16 (and kills no longer practise it), Stealth 8 -> 6 (and a creature can fail to notice you even at rank 1).

identification.name: Identification
identification.description: Telling what a broken Tower Artifact was. Your rank is the highest rarity you can identify (1 Common ... 6 Unique). Studying an artifact one rarity beyond you can't identify it, but still teaches you. Acumen makes practice count for more.

marksmanship.name: Marksmanship
marksmanship.description: Shooting straight. Each rank above 1 adds 2 to your accuracy with a bow. Every shot at a creature is practice (a hit counts double). Celerity makes practice count for more. Rank 3: Steady hand (no accuracy lost to distance); rank 5: Aimed shot (ready with z).

medicine.name: Medicine
medicine.description: Tending wounds in the field. Using a bandage stops bleeding, and a poultice stops poison; your rank sets how often it works (50% at rank 1, +10% a rank). From rank 2, a bandage also mends a minor injury outright. Every try is practice (a success counts double). Acumen makes practice count for more. The healer trains it.

scholarship.name: Scholarship
scholarship.description: Reading what others wrote: old hands, archaic scripts, ciphers. Your rank is the hardest writing you can read (1 to 6). Trying to read one a rank beyond you can't succeed, but still teaches you. Acumen makes practice count for more. The Academy librarian trains it.

blades.name: Blades
blades.description: Fighting with swords. Each rank above 1 adds 1 to your accuracy with it; ranks 3 and 5 each add 1 to its damage. Rank 3 brings a passive technique, rank 5 one you ready with z. Every blow is practice (a hit counts double). Placeholders (v0.55.0). The trainer in the guild hall's training corner trains it.

axes.name: Axes
axes.description: Fighting with axes. Each rank above 1 adds 1 to your accuracy with it; ranks 3 and 5 each add 1 to its damage. Rank 3 brings a passive technique, rank 5 one you ready with z. Every blow is practice (a hit counts double). Placeholders (v0.55.0). The trainer trains it.

hafted.name: Hafted
hafted.description: Fighting with picks, mauls and the like. Each rank above 1 adds 1 to your accuracy with it; ranks 3 and 5 each add 1 to its damage. Rank 3 brings a passive technique, rank 5 one you ready with z. Every blow is practice (a hit counts double). Placeholders (v0.55.0). The trainer trains it.

brawling.name: Brawling
brawling.description: Fighting bare-handed. Each rank above 1 adds 1 to your accuracy with it; ranks 3 and 5 each add 1 to its damage. Rank 3 brings a passive technique, rank 5 one you ready with z. Every blow is practice (a hit counts double). Placeholders (v0.55.0). The trainer trains it.

angling.name: Angling
angling.description: Fishing. At rank 2 a bite gives you a turn longer to strike and wary fish don't slip the hook so easily; fish of a tier up to your rank show what they're about to do on the line, and from rank 3 every fish does. Practice: bites, fights, catches (bigger fish teach more). Trained by the tackleman. Placeholders (v0.94.0).

tracking.name: Tracking
tracking.description: Reading the ground. Creatures leave tracks you can see, longer with rank; at rank 2 you sense what an area holds as you enter it; at 3 a marked bounty shows on your minimap; at 4 and up, creatures near you do. Practice: new areas. Trained by the trainer. Placeholders (v0.56.0).

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.description: Not being noticed. A creature that sees you notices you only by chance (most of the time at rank 1, less each rank after); blows at a creature that hasn't noticed you land more often and harder. Practice: slipping past a creature, striking unnoticed. Trained by the trainer. Placeholders (v0.56.0).

harvesting.name: Harvesting
harvesting.description: Taking what a creature leaves. Materials more often (+5% a rank above 1), and one more of each at ranks 3 and 5. Practice: every material a kill leaves. Trained by the smith. Placeholders (v0.56.0).

survival.name: Survival
survival.description: Living out there. A shorter rest after hunts, rations that mend for longer, torches that burn longer, and from rank 4 bleeding and poison that run half as long. Practice: coming home from hunts, rations, torches. Trained by the healer. Placeholders (v0.56.0).

attunement.name: Attunement
attunement.description: A feel for Jodebris and the artifacts it drives. Your windcatcher drains 10% slower a rank above 1; at rank 3 artifacts with limited uses get one more each hunt; at rank 5 you have a fourth artifact slot. Practice: using artifacts, and moving between areas on a hunt with Jodebris in your windcatcher. Trained by the artificer. Placeholders (v0.57.0).

bargaining.name: Bargaining
bargaining.description: Getting a better price. The supplier and the artificer deal 3% better a rank above 1, both ways: you pay less, they pay more, and repairs cost less. Practice: every trade. Trained by the supplier. Placeholders (v0.59.0).

knives.name: Knives
knives.description: Fighting with daggers and knives. Each rank above 1 adds 1 to your accuracy with it; ranks 3 and 5 each add 1 to its damage. Every blow is practice (a hit counts double). Rank 3: Backstab (an unnoticed hit does double damage); rank 5: Flurry (two strikes at once), readied with z. The trainer trains it. Placeholders (v0.78.0).

whips.name: Whips
whips.description: Fighting with whips, at a distance: a whip strikes a creature two cells away in a straight line. Each rank above 1 adds 1 to your accuracy with it; ranks 3 and 5 each add 1 to its damage. Every blow is practice (a hit counts double). Rank 3: Crack (+2 accuracy striking at two cells); rank 5: Snare (the creature can't move for 3 turns), readied with z. The trainer trains it. Placeholders (v0.78.0).

staves.name: Staves
staves.description: Fighting with a staff. Each rank above 1 adds 1 to your accuracy with it; ranks 3 and 5 each add 1 to its damage. Every blow is practice (a hit counts double). Rank 3: Guard (+2 evasion); rank 5: Sweep (strike everything beside you, each staggered a turn), readied with z. The trainer trains it. Placeholders (v0.78.0).

crossbows.name: Crossbows
crossbows.description: Shooting a crossbow. Each rank above 1 adds 2 to your accuracy with it. Every shot at a creature is practice (a hit counts double). Rank 3: Braced (+2 accuracy when you didn't move the turn before); rank 5: Piercing bolt (the bolt hits everything in its line), readied with z. The trainer trains it. Placeholders (v0.78.0).

claws.name: Claws
claws.description: Fighting with claws and katars: quick and close. Each rank above 1 adds 1 to your accuracy with it; ranks 3 and 5 each add 1 to its damage. Every blow is practice (a hit counts double). Rank 3: Rake (a hit bleeds 20% of the time); rank 5: Frenzy (your next three blows take no time), readied with z. The trainer trains it. Placeholders (v0.78.0).

polearms.name: Polearms
polearms.description: Fighting with spears and glaives, at a distance: a polearm strikes a creature two cells away in a straight line. Each rank above 1 adds 1 to your accuracy with it; ranks 3 and 5 each add 1 to its damage. Every blow is practice (a hit counts double). Rank 3: Set (a free strike at a creature that steps into reach); rank 5: Impale (a blow that ignores armour and staggers), readied with z. The trainer trains it. Placeholders (v0.78.0).
